GoalStateCompletion.dc.html.title: State 2 · Half marathon, no race yet

t0.text: runcoach · main flow, left to right. Press Play on any screen and tap through.

n1.text:
Backend behind screens 1 to 4

POST /api/onboarding saves all answers in one request and returns the feasibility verdict for the goal (see the states page for the mock rules).

POST /api/plans generates the plan from profile + goal with versioned rules. Deterministic: same input, same plan.

Entities: RunnerProfile, RunningGoal, TrainingPlan, TrainingWeek, ScheduledWorkout, WorkoutStep.

Milestone 1 is screens 1 to 4 without accounts; accounts come in milestone 2.

n2.text:
Backend behind screens 5 to 8

GET /api/today returns one object: date, today's workout or rest, next three sessions, the latest plan revision, and the coach sentence.

The coach sentence is server-generated from reason codes and templates (CALF_SORENESS_EASED, REST_BEFORE_HARD_DAY), never free text, so it is testable.

GET /api/workouts/{id}/move-options returns the days the recovery rule allows (screen 7), so the client never computes rules.

POST /api/workouts/{id}/results with an idempotency key: the phone may retry. Feedback defaults are derived from the result and sent back as the user's answers only if they tap Done.

Entities: WorkoutResult, RecoveryFeedback, PlanRevision.

n3.text:
Backend behind screens 9 and 10

GET /api/plans/current returns the 14-week volume shape, per-week done/missed/eased counts and the latest revision.

GET /api/plans/current/revisions is the change log. Undo = POST /api/plans/current/revisions/{id}/undo, which creates a new compensating revision rather than deleting history.

Pause, restart, end are state transitions on TrainingPlan (ACTIVE, PAUSED, ENDED) with a reason and an optional duration. Changing goal or schedule regenerates the weeks ahead only; completed weeks are immutable.

Concurrency question for later: two devices editing the plan at once.

t4.text: Screen 2 in five states · same artboard, different presets. Not part of the flow.

n4.text:
Backend behind screens 11 and 12

GET /api/progress/summary aggregates volume, adherence (done, missed, eased), easy-pace trend and personal records. Each metric carries measured or estimated.

GET and PUT /api/profile hold the onboarding answers. A PUT that changes goal or schedule re-runs feasibility and regenerates the plan ahead, and records a PlanRevision with reason PROFILE_CHANGED.

Account settings (units, reminders, sign out) belong to milestone 2 with Spring Security.
